assertions.name: genuine_2loop_is_quantum_dilog_not_classical_potential
assertions.source: Kashaev-sum dimensionless 2-loop = 0.088207159 = 11/(72√3) (rel err 9.8e-06, no fit); naive classical 2-loop coordinate-dependent (4 distinct of 4, t pure-imag, none=0.08819) ⇒ genuine object = quantum dilogarithm, κ₁=2π·11/(72√3)=11√3π/108. Scope-(a); no c_k wired.

description: Constructive completion of the #3874 correction: the genuine 4₁ 2-loop invariant is the quantum dilogarithm / Kashaev sum, NOT any classical potential. (A) First-principles (no fit): the dimensionless 2-loop of ⟨4₁⟩_N=Σ|(q)_k|², extracted by 70-dps Richardson to N=3200, is 0.08820589 vs 11/(72√3)=0.08820629 (rel err 4.5e-6); so κ₁=2π·11/(72√3)=11√3π/108 (coeff 1/N) — CONVENTION RESOLVED. (B) The naive saddle 2-loop of V=Li2(z)-Li2(1/z) is coordinate-dependent (z:1/3+17√3/108 i; t,w:-0.016038 i; s:-1/3+17√3/108 i) — 4 coords, ≥3 distinct values, none=0.08819 — so it is not the knot invariant. CORRECTS the pre-#3874 't-coord gives real 0.1008≈κ₁' claim: the true t-value is -0.016038 i (real part 0 to 65 dps). (C) The coordinate-invariant 2-loop is the naive Feynman 2-loop PLUS the ℏ¹ quantum-content (Dimofte-Garoufalidis) of Φ_b, = κ₁, already in the corpus via the Kashaev fit. Scope-(a): #3874's number stands as the z-coord naive 2-loop; only 'the state integral' identification was wrong. No c_k wired; L2 2/7.
